BJJ Phenom Nicholas Meregali Shares His World-Class Fundamentals of Jiu Jitsu: Closed Distance Open Guard System Designed To Get Underneath Opponents and Score Sweeps, Backtakes, AND Submissions

In this series you get to see inside the mind and the techniques that have been responsible for the best modern guard play in the world. The beauty of Meregali's guard is the high level execution of fundamentals using modern guard. This beautiful mix of old school and new school is truly unique to Nicholas. 

Who Is This Instructional For?

This instructional is made for anyone at any level. Regardless of body type, skill level, athletic level, or anything, there is something to learn from Meregali's gi game. Specifically, his under the hips series. This series was made to showcase the simplicity of his system that is effective at all levels. products.title: Fundamentals of Jiu-Jitsu: Standing Guard Passing by Nicholas Meregali
products.body:
BJJ Great Nicholas Meregali Provides A Comprehensive Fundamentals of Jiu-Jitsu: Standing Guard Passing system That Includes Creating Incredible Pressure, Precise Passing Combinations, Loose to Tight Style Passing and MORE!

  • Nicholas Meregali is one of the most accomplished competitors in the history of the sport having earned multiple IBJJF world titles!
  • Develop a complete passing system with Meregali’s outside passing system that exhausts opponents with constant pressure, continuous camping, and precise finishing sequences that allow them to fully settle into dominant position.
  • Discover the benefits of camping when passing the guard, and force opponents to stay in defensive posture as you systematically work towards a variety of passes.
  • Meregali shares his outside passing system that includes toreandos, leg drags, knee cuts, stack passes, and longstep passes that have been proven at the highest levels of competition!
  • Troubleshoot common grips, reactions, and guard variations by combining Nicholas’s immense top pressure with outside passing combinations that are sure to overwhelm good guard players.
  • Make guard passing one of your strongest assets with Nicholas Meregali’s 6-part Masterclass on top pressure and outside passing!


Check Out A Free Technique!

What Will You Learn?

This is your chance to learn the system of the best gi passer in the world today, Nicholas has a dynamic and simple system that has helped him easily pass the guard of many champions. 

While some assume that his system is a modern style, he has a brilliant balance of modern BJJ and high level fundamental BJJ. Nicholas is able to use combination passing from loose to tight and get from a standing position to a pressure position through these unique combinations. 

Positions like the knee cut, leg drag, top pressure, are where his standing passes are aimed to get. This instructional is a GAME CHANGING approach to passing guard. 

Who Is It For? 

This simple to use and high level passing system has something to offer ANYONE. Whether you are short, tall, big, small, white belt or black belt, you WILL learn something guaranteed. While there are extremely high level details and underlying concepts, there are also very basic fundamentals that Nicholas uses to be able to execute these techniques so often.

Volume 3

Cross Pant Control Behind The Leg    

Volume 4
Collar And Outside Top Pant Control    
Shoelace Trap    
Knee Cut From Camping Method  

Volume 5
Building The Half Camp Method  
Half Camp To Leg Drag    
3 Knee Tap Options From Half Camping    

Volume 6
Cutting Knee Over De La Riva   
Cutting Knee Over De La Riva With Pants Grip    
Half Camping With Pant Control Floating Pass And Knee Cut    
Breaking The Sleeve Control And Passing

Fundamentals of Jiu-Jitsu: Introduction To Meregali’s Gi System by Nicholas Meregali will change your gi game - Widely considered the greatest gi competitor in the world, his easy to use program is made for anyone with a basics to advanced approach - his approach to guard is science

  • Upgrade your bottom game with battle tested systems Nicholas has used at the highest levels of competition, including strategies from open guard, x-guard, single leg x, and collar/pant control!
  • Develop non stop passing pressure with next-level toreando passes that will leave guards in the dust!
  • Dominate from the top with easy-to-follow guides on how to flatten opponents for effective half guard passing as well as securing and stabilizing from the mount.
  • Discover crippling controls from the mount that expose high percentage submissions!
  • Meregali has one of the highest finishing percentages in the sport, and now you can learn his secrets to success for securing chokes from the back!
  • Revolutionize Your Gi Game With Winning Strategies From Both Bottom and Top Positions With Legendary Jiu-Jitsu Competitor Nicholas Meregali!


 Check Out a Free Technique!

What Will You Learn? 

This instructional is dedicated to a high level introduction of Meregali's game. Nicholas has an extremely unique game that is clearly working better than anyone else's at the highest level of the sport. 

With a modern approach to BJJ that still emphasizes the basics and fundamentals, he has absolutely beautiful BJJ. The misconception with his game, is that it is complex. This is because he beats world champions and ADCC champs so easily.

The truth is, Nicholas has a unique approach to fundamental BJJ mixed with modern BJJ. It is not difficult and in this basics to advanced approach you will see just how easy it is to use his style.

Who Is This For?

This series is for anyone at any level. Regardless of if you're a white belt or black belt, there is much to learn from Nicholas. His approach to BJJ is the future of the sport. Simplifying high level fundamentals into easy to implement concepts. That is the backbone of this instructional video.

Nicholas is going to walk you through his gi system and show you exactly how to start using these positions immediately.
